text: Former Schoolhouse by the Moy | Main Street, Foxford, Co. Mayo A Historic Schoolhouse Beautifully Restored – RTÉ Home of the Year 2023 Grand Finalist This is a truly distinctive four-bedroom residence situated in the heart of Foxford, County Mayo. Dating back to circa 1930, this remarkable property has a fascinating history and holds a special place in the heritage of Foxford. From 1952 to 1961, the building served as a girls' secondary school, welcoming generations of local students through its doors. In 1977, the property entered private family ownership, beginning another chapter in its history. In 2019, the present owners embarked on an extensive renovation, completely transforming the former schoolhouse into the beautiful family home that stands today. The restoration was undertaken with great care and attention to detail, retaining the charm and character of this historic building while introducing the comforts and conveniences of modern living. The result is a home filled with warmth, individuality and character, where every room has its own appeal. The exceptional quality of the transformation received national recognition in 2023 when the property featured on RTÉ's Home of the Year, progressing to the grand final of the prestigious competition. Internally, the accommodation offers four bedrooms, four beautifully finished bathrooms, a welcoming kitchen and a wonderful selection of living and reception areas. Throughout the property, inviting corners, comfortable seating areas and thoughtfully designed spaces create a home that is both practical and full of personality. Its distinctive architecture, carefully chosen finishes and beautifully presented interiors reflect the considerable work and attention invested in bringing this historic residence back to life. Situated on Main Street in Foxford, the property enjoys a central location within walking distance of local shops, cafés and amenities. Foxford is renowned for its rich heritage, the famous River Moy and the historic Foxford Woollen Mills. This property offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of genuine historical interest, beautifully restored and recognised nationally for its design and character. A property with a remarkable past, an exceptional transformation and a new chapter waiting to be written.
